---
title: "t_test"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(mosaic) 
library(car) 
View(KidsFeet)
```
```{r}
par(mfrow=c(3,2)) #this needs to be in an R script file
```


```{r}
t.test(KidsFeet$length, mu = 28, alternative = 'two.sided', conf.level = 0.95)
```
```{r}
qqPlot(KidsFeet$length)
```
```{r}
boxplot(KidsFeet$length)
```


```{r}
t.test(KidsFeet$length - (3*KidsFeet$width), mu = 0)
```
```{r}
qqPlot(KidsFeet$length - (3*KidsFeet$width))
```
```{r}
boxplot(KidsFeet$length - (3*KidsFeet$width))
```


```{r}
boy <- filter(KidsFeet, sex == "B")
View(boy)
girl <- filter(KidsFeet, sex == "G")
View(girl)
```


```{r}
t.test(girl$length, boy$length, mu = 0, alternative = 'two.sided', conf.level = 0.95)
```

```{r}
qqPlot(girl$length - boy$length)
```
```{r}
boxplot(girl$length, boy$length)
```
